description: Area Prevención Riesgos Inundaciones is a dataset listed in datos.gob.es, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Gobierno de las Illes Balears. Flood Risk Prevention Area. Coverage: Gobierno de las Illes Balears. The portal shows the English title as "Flood Risk Prevention Area" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Gobierno de las Illes Balears. Its keywords include áreas prevención riesgos, inundació, risk prevention areas, flood, área prevenció riscs, illes balears. The listing shows 2 download or service links in CSV, JSON. The listing shows 2026-06-10 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (http://www.opendefinition.org/licenses/cc-by). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-datos-gob-es.
